title: refused (server -> bridge)
description: The answer to a hello that is not accepted (Arkab.Protocol.refused/1); the server closes the socket. revoked: the bridge forgets this server. Any other reason: shown on the bridge's page and tried again in 60 s.

reason.description: version: the server does not speak the bridge's v. key: not a key the server knows. revoked: the bridge was removed on the server.
